The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the migration (#562 un-bakes headings, #563 wires the tree, #564 makes invariants leaves). Growing it needs an issue. `note` is for the human reader only; the key is check + id/pair.
